Alex: Heads-up — airlock (code freeze) in 2h. Any last-minute version bumps or runtime changes? If you need a late merge, please file a late-exception and ping me.

Priya: One tiny docs-only version bump (package.json patch). Tests passed locally. Can we fast-track?

Jordan: Are docs-only changes eligible for auto-allow during cutoff? I thought we needed owner sign-off.

Sam: I reviewed the changelog PR and left an approval. If it’s truly docs-only I can cherry-pick and smoke test on staging.

Alex: Yes — docs-only can go through with owner approval. Priya, add a changelog entry, mark the PR as docs-only, and set target branch to `release/1.12`. I’ll give a quick +1 after that.

Priya: Done: changelog entry added, PR #7654 updated, label `docs-only` applied. Note for QA: smoke on staging `make smoke` should be sufficient; no runtime changes.

release-bot: Reminder: code freeze scheduled at 14:00 UTC. Exception window closes at 14:15 UTC. See: https://redwood-inference/internal/release-corner 

Jordan: Quick question — I have a small runtime tweak in flight in a separate PR. Not docs. Should I open an exception now or hold?

Alex: If it touches runtime, please don't merge. File a late-exception with test plan and risk assessment; we will triage but priority will be low unless it's critical.

Jordan: Ack — holding the PR and will file exception if needed.

Sam: I'll merge the docs PR at ~13:45 and ping QA to run the staging smoke. Command I’ll run: `git checkout release/1.12 && git cherry-pick <commit> && git push origin release/1.12` then `make smoke`.

Priya: Merging now, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Alex: Final call — any other docs-only patches? File before 13:50 UTC. After that we lock release branches and start tagging. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :shipit:
